title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 43
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 43: the glory of God returning by the east gate, and the measurements and ordinances of the altar.

questions.text: From which way did the glory of the God of Israel come?
questions.explanation: The glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east, and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

answers.text: From the way of the east
From the way of the north
From the way of the sea
From the way of the south

questions.explanation: His voice was like the sound of many waters, and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

answers.text: Like the sound of a ram's horn
Like a low and quiet whisper
Like the sound of many waters
Like a lion roaring in the forest

questions.text: By which river had the prophet seen a vision like this one?
questions.explanation: He says the visions were like the vision that he saw by the river Chebar, and he fell on his face.

questions.text: What did he see when the Spirit brought him into the inner court?
questions.explanation: The Spirit took him up and brought him into the inner court, and Yahweh's glory filled the house.

answers.text: The east gate had been shut
The altar was covered with blood

questions.text: What does Yahweh call this place where he will dwell among the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: He calls it the place of his throne and the place of the soles of his feet, where he will dwell among the children of Israel forever.

answers.text: The place of the prince's gift
A place for burial in Israel
The place of the boiling houses

questions.text: Why is the son of man to show the house to the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: He is to show the house to the house of Israel so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities, and let them measure the pattern.

answers.text: So that they may rebuild it quickly
So that they may be ashamed of their iniquities
So that they may sell its stones
So that the prince may claim it

questions.text: Which cubit is used for the measurements of the altar?
questions.explanation: The measurements of the altar are given in cubits, and the text explains that the cubit is a cubit and a hand width.

answers.text: A cubit and a hand width

questions.text: What were the measurements of the altar hearth?
questions.explanation: The altar hearth was to be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

questions.text: What is to be given to the Levitical priests of the offspring of Zadok for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says to give the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok a young bull for a sin offering.

questions.text: For how many days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it?
questions.explanation: Seven days they shall prepare a goat for a sin offering each day, and seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and purify it.
